hypotheses.binder: (hupper : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → ‖N n x‖ ≤ M)
hypotheses.justification: The inverse-square jets need only the positive lower bound. Set q n x = ‖N n x‖². By PolynomialJets.norm_sq, q has polynomial jets, and hb with hlower gives q ≥ b² > 0 on the domain. Mathlib's iter_deriv_inv and norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv bound the kth derivative of inversion there by k! / (b²)^(k+1), independently of any upper bound. Applying norm_iteratedFDerivWithin_comp_le as in PolynomialJets.compact_comp therefore gives polynomial jets for q⁻¹ without hupper. Use polynomialJets_unweighted and then retain the numerator, multiplication, and band_smul arguments of the existing proof. Empty domains cause no difficulty; zero normals are excluded on the domain, and zero frequencies remain valid because division by zero and the corresponding inverse-carrier multiplier are both zero.
